audit.method: Legilux's HTML of the version each act's Text: trailer names (legilux.public.lu/filestore/.../fr/html; the check and verify read its XML), its hidden parts (struck-through text, modification markers) left out: every line of the act's files, letters and digits, found on the page: whole, or without a list number build.py writes from the list's symbol, or in parts split at colons and quotation marks, or 4 in 5 of its runs of four words (the page numbers a quoted provision's items, which build.py writes on one line without their numbers)

flags.detail: 4 laws at Legilux are not here with no reason found
1 laws new or changed at Legilux over 7 days ago are not here yet

legilux|luxembourg/national/acts.note: Legilux lists 9,277 laws and the Constitution: 8,077 in force or not yet in force (the census), 1,200 no longer in force (435 in this repository's history, 765 listed in data/actes/loi.csv, 0 neither); not counted as gaps (README: What it does not show): 886 laws in force Legilux has only as scanned Mémorial pages (no XML) and 266 laws in force about named private persons (adopted since 1926), each listed in data/actes/loi.csv with metadata and link, not as text; Legilux's 142,704 acts of other kinds (43,834 Mémorial B publications, 33,396 communal regulations, 15,404 règlements grand-ducaux, 12,782 arrêtés ministériels, ...) are outside this corpus's text (corpus.json: the Constitution and the laws); the repository lists part of them with metadata and link in data/actes/ (PLAN.md); not compared in this check

verify.method: the XML of the version each held act's Text: trailer names, read again from Legilux's file store (legilux.public.lu/filestore, 1015 reads this check, 1 s apart), rendered by the act's own builder (wave3, build_bulk, build.py), and compared with the act's files at the tip of main, git blob by git blob (the two history acts article by article, letters and digits); a rotating sweep reads every held act within 7 days (987 of 6903 this check), with the acts this check wrote (7); a text that differs is corrected by the next check's update (Kind: correction)
